method.description: Read frozen monthly generated candidate cohorts only and evaluate the preregistered hard filters plus the all-pass burst trigger before any outcome / benchmark calculation.
method.validation_command: PowerShell pipeline into bundled Python, reading result/a_short/backtest/generated/*/candidates.csv and applying the preregistered hard filters / signal conditions.

evaluation_result.interpretation: The corrected-basis preregistered trigger has zero valid signal events on the frozen steady Tier1 universe. It fails the preregistered power / event-count gate before any return, benchmark, drawdown, or concentration statistic can be informative.

diagnostic_notes: The individual signal conditions are not impossible: among Tier1 rows, pct_5d >= 6.0 appears 17 times, amount expansion >= 1.5 appears 38 times, and is_breakout == true appears 7 times.
The three signals never co-occur inside the preregistered Tier1 / safe-entry universe.
Across all 360 rows, the all-pass signal appears 3 times, but all 3 rows are Tier2 with chasing-high entry flags and are excluded by the preregistered hard filters.
This preflight does not prove that a redesigned A-share burst universe has alpha; it proves only that the current steady-watchlist universe cannot test the preregistered burst trigger.

Changing the universe, relaxing Tier1 / entry-flag exclusions, changing is_breakout, changing the signal conjunction, or changing thresholds is a new promotion-relevant degree of freedom and requires a singleton program-level test-budget ledger before a new preregistration runs.
